# RateCraft - Freelance Pricing & Hourly Rate Intelligence

> RateCraft (https://ratecraft.app/) is a free, high-performance, client-side financial calculator suite built for freelancers, independent contractors, and solo consultants worldwide. It calculates minimum viable hourly rates, dedicated day rates, weekly sprint retainers, and fixed project quotes with built-in scope risk buffers, tax liability accounting, and operational overhead coverage.

## Core Formula Architecture

RateCraft uses a rigorous bottom-up financial equation rather than simplistic salary division:

1. **Target Net Income**: The freelancer's desired personal take-home pay.
2. **Gross Revenue Requirement**: `Effective Gross Salary = Target Net Income ÷ (1 - Tax Rate)`
3. **Break-Even Revenue**: `Effective Gross Salary + Annual Business Expenses (tools, equipment, accounting)`
4. **Target Gross Revenue**: `Break-Even Revenue × (1 + Profit Margin Buffer for growth & savings)`
5. **Annual Billable Hours**: `(52 Weeks - Vacation Weeks - Sick Leave Weeks) × (Weekly Hours × Billable Percentage)`
   * *Industry Standard*: 58.4% to 62.5% of working hours are billable (20–25 hrs/week in a 40-hr week).
6. **Recommended Hourly Rate**: `Target Gross Revenue ÷ Annual Billable Hours`
7. **Day Rate**: `Hourly Rate × (Weekly Hours ÷ 5)` (standard 8-hour equivalent)
8. **Weekly Sprint Retainer**: `Hourly Rate × Weekly Billable Hours`
9. **Fixed Project Quote**: `(Project Estimated Hours × Hourly Rate) × (1 + Scope Risk Buffer %)`

## 2026 Global Rate Benchmarks (RateCraft Research)

- **Software Engineering & Cloud Architecture**:
  - Mid-Level: $75 – $110 / hr (€70 – €100 / hr)
  - Senior / Full-Stack: $125 – $185 / hr (€115 – €170 / hr)
  - Sprint Retainer (2-Week Agile): $10,000 – $18,000
- **UI/UX & Product Design**:
  - Mid-Level Product Designer: $55 – $80 / hr (€50 – €75 / hr)
  - Senior UX / Design Systems Lead: $100 – $160 / hr (€95 – €150 / hr)
  - Weekly Design Sprint: $3,000 – $8,000
- **Virtual Assistants & Executive Support**:
  - General Administrative VA: $25 – $40 / hr
  - Executive VA / OBM: $45 – $75 / hr
  - Monthly Support Retainer (20h/mo): $600 – $1,500
- **Video Editing & Post-Production**:
  - Social Media & Shorts Editor: $40 – $70 / hr ($350 – $600 / day)
  - Commercial & Documentary Editor: $75 – $130 / hr ($700 – $1,150 / day)
- **Consulting & Strategic Advisory**:
  - Management Consultant Day Rate: $1,200 – $2,500 / day
  - Principal Partner / Fractional Executive: $2,500 – $4,000+ / day
  - Monthly Strategic Retainer: $5,000 – $15,000 / mo
- **Social Media Management**:
  - Freelance Social Manager: $35 – $65 / hr ($1,500 – $2,800 / mo per brand)
  - Full-Funnel Content Strategist: $75 – $110 / hr ($3,500 – $6,000+ / mo)

## Tools & Programmatic Calculators

- [RateCraft General Freelance Calculator](https://ratecraft.app/): Comprehensive hourly rate, day rate, and project quote calculator with dynamic breakdown visualization and downloadable rate cards.
- [UK Freelance Day Rate Calculator](https://ratecraft.app/uk-freelance-day-rate-calculator/): Tailored for British contractors, consultants, and limited company directors calculating GBP (£) day rates across Inside vs. Outside IR35, National Insurance, Corporation Tax, and unbilled bench periods.
- [Canada Freelance Rate Calculator](https://ratecraft.app/canada-freelance-rate-calculator/): Built for Canadian contractors calculating CAD (C$) hourly and day rates factoring CRA self-employment, double CPP obligations, and the C$30k GST/HST rule.
- [Australia Freelance Rate Calculator](https://ratecraft.app/australia-freelance-rate-calculator/): Built for Australian sole traders and Pty Ltd directors calculating AUD (A$) rates factoring ATO taxes, 12% Superannuation Guarantee, and the A$75k GST threshold.
- [Freelance Developer Hourly Rate Calculator](https://ratecraft.app/developer-rate-calculator/): Tailored for software engineers, full-stack developers, mobile engineers, and technical architects.
- [Freelance Designer Hourly Rate Calculator](https://ratecraft.app/designer-rate-calculator/): Built for UI/UX designers, brand identity specialists, design systems experts, and art directors.
- [Freelance Copywriter Hourly Rate Calculator](https://ratecraft.app/copywriter-rate-calculator/): Designed for B2B copywriters, conversion copywriters, and content strategists.
- [Virtual Assistant Rate Calculator](https://ratecraft.app/virtual-assistant-rate-calculator/): Calculates sustainable hourly rates and monthly package retainers for virtual assistants factoring in self-employment taxes, SaaS tooling, and unbillable admin time.
- [Video Editor Rate Calculator](https://ratecraft.app/video-editor-rate-calculator/): Calculates hourly, daily, and project fees for video editors accounting for workstation hardware depreciation, DaVinci/Adobe licenses, and rendering downtime.
- [Consultant Day Rate Calculator](https://ratecraft.app/consultant-day-rate-calculator/): Calculates commercial day rates, half-day fees, and monthly advisory retainers for independent strategy, management, and technical consultants.
- [Social Media Manager Rate Calculator](https://ratecraft.app/social-media-manager-rate-calculator/): Calculates hourly rates and monthly client retainer packages for social media managers factoring in scheduling tools, video reels creation, and client limits.
